why: OB4 (open-plots build-out, G978): Ember Forge's 8 x 8 grid of 62.5 m tiles after round 62's top-down (art/grid/round-62-open-plot-palettes/17-ember-forge.jpg): the furnace hall at the plaza, a moat of lava channels round it (Night Market's canals and bends in the row's lava water kind, bridged where the avenues cross), forge courts (F) and ore yards (O) round the moat and flanking the four road entries. Mirror-symmetric: each row reads the same from either end, the south half the north turned twice. The landmark is sp-o2's furnace.py script take (35 m, turned to face the south road); no plaza poster (the furnace is the plaza's hero) and a 448 x 252 entry poster, as Lantern Bayou fits its tile caps.
